newsitem.title: USA: Rank says in talks with Trump Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Rank says in talks with Trump Hotel.

text.p: Rank Organisation Plc said Thursday it is in negotiations with Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc to transform the Trump Castle in Atlantic City into a Hard Rock Cafe & Casino.

In a brief statement from Rank's London headquarters, the British leisure and entertainment giant said the talks also include the possible construction of a Hard Rock Live entertainment venue and "other non-casino operations within a total Hard Rock-themed facility" at the Castle.
Rank declined to provide additional detail regarding the talks and officials at Hard Rock's Florida-based U.S. headquarters were not immediately available to comment.
Trump Hotel officials also were not immediately available.
With the statement, Rank confirmed an earlier Reuters report regarding the possible transformation of the Castle into a Hard Rock facility.
On Monday, Trump Hotels shareholders approved the acquisition of the Castle from Donald Trump, who is chairman of the publicly-held company.
Trump, owner of almost 40 percent of the Trump Hotels, did not vote his shares, and 82 percent of the votes cast were in favor of the $480 million acquisition, he said.
In early afternoon New York Stock Exchange trade, Trump Hotels shares were off 3/8 to 24-1/4 while Rank's Nasdaq-listed American Depositary Receipts were at 13-1/2, off 1/4.
